summary: Round 2. All four round-1 findings are fixed by real re-runs, not by rewording, and every new figure was checked against evidence the author did not point me at. MAJOR M3.7-1 is closed: http/build/test-results/memoryBoundCeilingTest/TEST-binjava.http.MemoryFlatAtIntervalCeilingTest.xml exists with tests=1 skipped=0 failures=0 errors=0 time=199.245, timestamp 2026-09-02T14:38:06.549Z, and the Gradle daemon log independently records 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 3m 20s / 14 actionable tasks: 14 executed' with -Xmx256m on the worker command line. Minor 1 closed: the seven module suites on disk sum to exactly 415 (binstore-backends 86, binstore-spi 29, client 15, format 122, http 36, ingest 93, plugin 34), all failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0, all timestamped inside one 17-second window, and the daemon log shows '48 actionable tasks: 48 executed' with nothing FROM-CACHE or UP-TO-DATE; client/build/test-results/test/TEST-binjava.client.ConsumerClientTest.xml confirms client's suite really ran, and ConsumerClient.java really does reference RunEntry/SegmentReader. Minor 2 closed: criterion 1 now states both directions of SPEC AC1 plus the 'proven against the threshold logic' qualifier, and names the shorten test with a pointer to criterion 3. Minor 3 closed and accurate against AGENTS.md: check-coverage.sh and check-suite-time.sh exist in scripts/ and are absent from .pre-commit-config.yaml; check-mutants.sh, the cost meter and the benchmark gates are the exact three AGENTS.md lists as not yet existing; the call-out that no gate measures M3's own request-rate completion condition is correct and is the right thing to say loudest. Also verified independently: clusterTest is 9 tests across the six named ITs with 0 failures and the log says 30s; check-module.sh reproduces 'ok 8 module(s) checked, rule5 tested 4, rule2 tested 2' verbatim; check-milestone-verified.sh reproduces '7 criteria, all with evidence'; all 30 named test methods still exist; golden/segment-v0.bin was last touched at M1.5 and segment-v1.bin at M3.0, as claimed; red records exist in .harness/tdd/red.json for every new M3 test except MemoryFlatAtIntervalCeilingTest, exactly as the did-not-run list says; M3.5 is the only M3 commit that skipped a gate and both of its skips are listed. Cost lens: the file makes no request-rate claim it has not measured -- criterion 4 is scoped as a modelled CountingBinStore test and the did-not-run list explicitly refuses to let it stand in for a cost budget. One minor factual slip introduced by the minor-1 fix, below.

findings.title: "the four this milestone touched" -- M3 touched three code modules, not four; plugin was never modified
findings.failure_scenario: The new paragraph justifying the all-modules run opens 'ALL modules, not the four this milestone touched. An earlier draft of this record ran only :format:test :ingest:test :http:test :plugin:test'. git diff --name-only 30436942..2ebfc4df (M2.17 exclusive through M3.5) touches only docs/, format/, http/ and ingest/ -- no file under plugin/ changed anywhere in M3. So the earlier draft's four-task set was not 'the modules this milestone touched'; plugin was in it for the same reason client should have been (it reads the directory entry), which is the very distinction this paragraph exists to draw. A reader auditing which modules M3 changed takes this sentence as the answer and gets a wrong one, in the single file whose stated value is that every line is literally true. The numbers are unaffected -- 285 is exactly 122+93+36+34 and 415 is exactly the seven suites on disk -- so this is prose about the fix, not evidence. Fix if it is being touched anyway: 'ALL modules, not the four an earlier draft picked'.
